sources.title: Churn model notes
sources.text: Churn risk score 0-100. Inputs: logins in last 30 days, open support tickets, contract months remaining. Retrained monthly. Does not use NPS.

turns.text: This view ranks accounts by churn risk, highest first.
Nice. Does the score take our NPS survey into account?

mustInclude: Answers no: the score uses logins, open support tickets and remaining contract months, not NPS
checkpoints.ideal: No, NPS isn't an input; it uses logins in the last 30 days, open tickets and months left on the contract.
